text:
Good question! 🌿

No, Leafy Plus doesn't make Express shipping free. Express is **$14.95** and is never free, even for members.

What Leafy Plus does include is **free Standard shipping with no minimum order**. Standard delivery takes:
- **Zone 1** (under 300 miles): 2-3 business days
- **Zone 2** (300-1,000 miles): 3-5 business days
- **Zone 3** (over 1,000 miles, remote and island addresses): 5-8 business days

Express is available in Zones 1 and 2 only (next business day and 2 business days), and isn't available in Zone 3.

Also worth remembering from earlier: using free Standard shipping counts as using a benefit, so it would affect your 14-day refund option.

Thanks for asking, and please reach out any time if you have more questions. Happy planting! 🌱
